source.name: Paris Basketball — Paris Basketball unveils its 2026–2027 home and away kits
source.note: Kit maker; the 2026-27 home and away kits are designed in collaboration with adidas. No front-of-shirt sponsor for 2026-27 was announced at the last check (2026-10-01): the launch article names no shirt sponsor, and the 24 September Winamax announcement gives Winamax the back of the EuroLeague shirt only.
source.quote: With the start of the 2026–2027 season fast approaching, Paris Basketball unveils its home and away kits, designed in collaboration with adidas.

source.name: Paris Basketball — Winamax becomes an official partner of Paris Basketball
source.note: Three-season deal from 2026-27; on the back of the shirt in EuroLeague matches only (home and away), with on-court branding in the domestic Betclic Élite.
source.quote: From this season onwards, Winamax will feature on the back of the Parisian team’s shirts during EuroLeague matches, both home and away.

summary: adidas-made home kit (launched 12 September 2026); Winamax on the back of the EuroLeague shirt. No front-of-shirt sponsor announced for 2026-27 as of 1 October 2026; sleeve and shorts placements not checked, so the sponsor list may be incomplete.
